# SECTION 3 -- THE BUILD-GRAPH FIX THAT WAS REQUIRED
# Two PRE-EXISTING defects in src/CMakeLists.txt blocked a FRESH
# production build of the driver subject. Both were reproduced on the
# unmodified C0 tree and are therefore NOT introduced by this ACT.
# DEFECT 1 -- LITERAL QUOTES IN THE PRODUCER INVOCATION.
#   The WP-001 producer rule passed --install-dir="<path>". CMake's
#   VERBATIM mode escapes the argument list ITSELF, so the producer
#   received the two quote characters as LITERAL path bytes and built
#   the header path "<prefix>"/include/tos.HH, which does not exist.
#   FIX: the argument is passed WITHOUT literal quotes, which is the
#   form this file already used for every other producer (see the
#   AST-BINOP, COMPOUND-BLOCK and STATEMENT-DISPATCH producer rules).
# DEFECT 2 -- ABSOLUTE OUTPUT PATH IN THE PRODUCER INVOCATION.
#   The production compiler's object-emission command prefixes its
#   output path with "./" (src/main.c, the -o ./%s form). An ABSOLUTE
#   output path therefore becomes ".//abs/path" and the assembler
#     clang -cc1as: error: unable to open output file './/<abs>/x.o'
#   FIX: the -o argument is RELATIVE to an explicit WORKING_DIRECTORY.
# The same two defects remain at the AST-UNARY and SWITCH-ARM producer
# rules in the same file. They are OUT OF THIS ACT'S SCOPE (those
# subjects are not on the required route) and are recorded as RESIDUE
# REPRODUCTION ON THE UNMODIFIED C0 TREE
